testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect and cancels the new single-user project wizard: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-project-dialog-source/features/application/project-dialog/project-dialog.feature:35:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect and cancels the new single-user project wizard ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with `fixtures/cad/project-dialog-native/WizardProject.opj` as its first project ✔ And the user opens the Projects dialog from the template chooser with `WizardProject` active ✔ And the wizard fixture has no entries in either library list ✔ When the user chooses New ✔ Then the new-project wizard opens on a project-type page ✔ And New Single User Project is selected ✔ And the Next and cancels controls are available ✔ When the user chooses Next ✔ Then the wizard displays a project name, workspace folder and project file to be created ✔ And it provides a folder browsing control ✔ When the user chooses Next ✔ Then the wizard displays a Select Libraries page ✔ And the page has All Projects and New Project lists with transfer controls ✔ And both library lists are empty ✔ And a provisional project entry is visible in the project list behind the wizard ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the wizard closes and the Projects dialog is displayed ✔ And the provisional project entry is no longer listed ✔ And the original project remains marked active
